# bolero list should skip 'ignore' directives for indexed modules in the module cache
# See golang.org/issue/42965

env BOLERO_MODCACHE=$WORK${/}modcache
bolero get example.com/ignore/...@v1.0.0
bolero list -x example.com/ignore/...
stderr 'ignoring directory '$BOLERO_MODCACHE''${/}'example.com'${/}'ignore@v1.0.0'${/}'foo'

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.24

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
